responsibility: Handles LRA spilling by assigning spilled pseudos to reusable stack slots or, on supporting targets, alternate hard registers, and by rewriting RTL to use those locations. It packs spilled pseudos into slots based on frequency, size, alignment, and nonoverlapping live ranges, creates spill memories, performs pseudo-to-memory substitutions, and finally applies the last code changes that replace assigned pseudos with hard registers, remove temporary LRA markers and useless self-moves, and clean up debug-only leftovers. This is LRA’s spill-location and final-substitution implementation.
